invariants: 2 above the rule, 3 below. The asymmetry is what lets the claim hold the left of the upper band; balancing it to 2+2 or 3+3 forces the claim out and the slide becomes a plain stat grid.
Direction is a GLYPH, not a colour. .stat--pos alone does not read from the back of a room.
The rule starts to the right of the claim, not at the content edge — it divides the numbers, not the slide.
One highlight, inside the claim. The numerals are navy; only the direction glyphs are orange.
